evals.prompt: Scan my Dockerfile before I build — looking for misconfig and base-image CVEs.
evals.expected_output: A Vulnetix container analysis of the Dockerfile with findings on base-image risk, EOL bases, exposed secrets, missing USER, root processes, healthchecks, and vulnerable system packages.
expectations: Findings table includes columns Severity, Source, Issue, File / Layer, Fix
A Hardening checklist section covers USER directive, healthcheck, pinned versions, layer minimisation
Summary is written to `.vulnetix/containers/<timestamp>.summary.yaml` with finding counts by severity

evals.prompt: Audit registry.example.com/myapp:1.4 for installed-package CVEs using whatever scanners I have available.
evals.expected_output: A composed scan against the registry image using Trivy/Grype when present, with results merged into a unified de-duped table.
expectations: `trivy image registry.example.com/myapp:1.4 --format json` is invoked when `binaries.trivy: true`
`grype registry.example.com/myapp:1.4 -o json` is invoked when `binaries.grype: true`
Findings are merged into a unified table and de-duplicated by CVE + package
Skill aborts with a one-liner if no container artifacts are found AND no `--image` argument is passed

evals.prompt: Build a CycloneDX SBOM for our prod image plus a CVE list.
evals.expected_output: Syft-generated CycloneDX JSON SBOM alongside a Vulnetix/Trivy CVE table for the same image.
expectations: `vulnetix scan --enable-containers` or `vulnetix containers` is invoked for the Vulnetix layer
Output table includes a Fix column with concrete remediation (e.g. base-image bump)
EOL base-image status is sourced from `vulnetix vdb product`
Findings are split per service-name when the input is a docker-compose.yml
